WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', activity_month) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', activity_month) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN monthly_member_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_activity" monthly_member_activity_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
answer: 统计范围为青禾当前数据范围内、全门店口径的完整自然月数据，按 2026 年 7 月和 8 月分别统计；人数单位为 CRM 会员账户数。结果：2026 年 7 月月内购买会员数 11 户、月内复购会员数 1 户，月内复购率 9.09%；2026 年 8 月月内购买会员数 15 户、月内复购会员数 12 户，月内复购率 80.00%。月内复购率为同月月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数。上述人数为按月口径，不能将两个月人数直接相加当作跨月去重人数。
question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。
